title: allium ampeloprasum var. porrum
intro: Allium ampeloprasum var. porrum, commonly known as leek, is a perennial plant belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. Leek is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of leek include exhibiting antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of leek include sulfur compounds, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
